summary: Stop refusing ISOs on SMB storage as writable: SMB mounts force file_mode=0600, so verifyISO now relies on regular file, size and SHA-256. API impact: none.

guide.reason: Restores the documented ISO import and VM creation workflow on SMB storage; no instructions change.

api.reason: API impact: none. vm-create, vm-update and vm-media commands and results are unchanged; only Core's local ISO integrity check changes.

roadmap.reason: Bug fix within the current storage milestone.

state.reason: No durable state added or changed.

verification.method: Regression case fails before the fix (0600 ISO refused) and passes after; changed content is still refused; go vet and go test -race ./internal/vmhost pass. Not re-run on a lab SMB host.
